name: Byodoin Temple
description: UNESCO World Heritage temple featuring the iconic Phoenix Hall reflected in a serene pond. Built in 1053, its architectural grace is depicted on Japan's 10-yen coin.
notes: Phoenix Hall interior tours require separate timed tickets.
notesJa: 【見どころ】10円玉に描かれた鳳凰堂と阿字池の水鏡が息を呑む美しさです。
reservation: Phoenix Hall interior ticket required on site
reservationJa: 【予約】鳳凰堂内部拝観は当日先着順の定員制となります。
parkingJa: 【駐車場】近隣にコインパーキングあり。
